hero.headline: Oil just fell to its lowest since August. Your gas tank is next.
hero.dek: Every story on FIOPO is traced to where it lands: your fuel, your rent, your savings, your job. Here is how today's biggest story travels.

chain.label: The event
chain.text: The IEA says oil supply now tops demand for the first time since the Iran war began, with a fourth quarter surplus of about 1.7 million barrels a day.

chain.label: Crude oil
chain.text: US crude settled Monday down 3.2%, its lowest close since August 28. Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44.

chain.label: Gas pump
chain.text: AAA national average on November 16, down from $4.36 in mid October. Still the priciest November on record.

chain.label: Interest rates
chain.text: Markets price about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed increase on December 9. Cheaper oil has not changed that yet.

chain.label: You
chain.text: Saved versus mid October, about $8 on a 15 gallon fill. Borrowing costs are the part still rising.

hero.caption: Sources: AAA national average November 16; NYMEX WTI and ICE Brent settlements November 16; IEA monthly report via FinanceFeeds; CME FedWatch November 16. The chain itself is FIOPO analysis.

stories.headline: Cheaper gas will not stop a likely Fed hike. Today's retail sales report is the next test.
stories.happened: Markets kept pricing about 91% odds of a quarter point Fed increase on December 9, even as oil slid. The 10 year Treasury yield, which steers mortgage rates, closed at 5.15% on Friday.
stories.happening: October retail sales come out at 7:30 a.m. Central today. Forecasters expect a 0.2% gain after September's 0.8%. The Fed's rate sits at 3.75% to 4.00%.

could.note: Market odds from CME FedWatch, November 16. Not a FIOPO forecast.

you: Credit cards and HELOCs move with the Fed almost one for one. Pay down variable balances before December 9.
Shopping for a mortgage? Rates follow the 10 year yield, which is near 5.1%. Lock if the payment works for you now.
Keep idle cash in an account paying close to the Fed rate. A hike helps savers a little.
stories.watch: retail sales this morning, Fed minutes Wednesday.

stories.headline: Tankers are burning near Hormuz, yet oil keeps falling. Here is why.
stories.happened: Iran's navy said a fourth tanker hit a mine in 24 hours. A separate tanker was disabled near Khasab, Oman, with the crew reported safe. The IRGC says it targeted US radar in Bahrain again on Tuesday.
stories.happening: Gulf exports have recovered faster than demand, the IEA says, so the market shrugged. Iran says a regional bloc backs its plan to reopen the strait within two days under a ceasefire. The White House calls Iran's demands unacceptable.

could.note: FIOPO read for the next 30 days. Judgment, not fact.

you: Pump prices should keep drifting lower into Thanksgiving unless shipping is hit hard.
Diesel dipped below $6 a gallon for the first time since September. Delivery and freight costs should ease with a lag.
Flying for the holidays? Book now. A spike would show up in fares within weeks.
stories.watch: whether the mine claims slow Hormuz traffic, and the OPEC+ meeting November 29.

stories.headline: Nvidia reports tonight and Anthropic lists Thursday. One week will set the mood for AI stocks.
stories.happened: Nvidia closed Monday at $156.14, down 4.1%, after its CEO's sudden exit and new US limits on chip access through overseas data centers. The Nasdaq fell 2.5%.
stories.happening: Nvidia reports after the close today under interim CEO Colette Kress. Anthropic set its IPO at $70 to $78 a share, up to a $1.404 trillion valuation, with trading expected Thursday under ANT on the Nasdaq.

could.text: A steady Nvidia outlook and a calm Anthropic debut would likely lift tech into December. A weak guide could make the IPO price at the low end and extend the slide.

you: If you own an S&P 500 or Nasdaq fund, you already own a lot of Nvidia. Big earnings day swings are normal.
Up to 20% of Anthropic's shares are set aside for retail investors. First day prices can swing hard, so size any purchase as money you can afford to see drop.
Check that your retirement plan is not more than you intended in a handful of tech names.
stories.watch: Nvidia guidance tonight and where Anthropic prices Wednesday evening.

stories.headline: APEC opens in Shenzhen Wednesday. Trump and Xi meet Thursday with the trade truce on the clock.
stories.happened: The EU sanctioned nearly 50 banks and financial firms tied to Russia and approved its largest single payment to Ukraine, about €8 billion. Last week's UAE talks produced a prisoner swap but no breakthrough.
stories.happening: APEC leaders meet November 18 and 19. Trump arrives late Wednesday and holds talks with Xi on Thursday, with a three way meeting with Putin also expected. A US official says Ukraine is not on that agenda. The US and China trade truce runs to January 10, 2027.

could.text: Most likely: warm words and a truce extension, with chips unresolved. The risk: the truce lapses in January and tariffs return on electronics, toys and clothing.

you: Phones, laptops and appliances made in China are safer to buy before January than after.
Watch for any line on chips. New US export rules already hit Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil.
stories.watch: any truce extension or tariff language after Thursday's meeting.

culture.headline: Baseball's labor deal expires December 1. A lockout looks likely, and the fight is over a salary cap.
culture.happened: MLB proposed delaying a salary cap to 2028, at $258.2 million with a $180.2 million floor. Players oppose a cap. The last cap fight led to the 1994 strike.
culture.happening: Teams are expected to rush free agent signings before the deal expires. Talks are unlikely to speed up until January.
culture.could: If 60 or more games are lost, national TV deals extend a year. A spring delay is possible. FIOPO read.
you: Hold off on 2027 season tickets and travel packages until a deal is signed, or buy only with a clear refund policy.

culture.headline: GTA 6 arrives Thursday at $79.99. Preorders alone are estimated near $750 million.
culture.happened: Sensor Tower estimates about 7.7 million copies were preordered. Take-Two's CEO says preorders are far above expectations.
culture.happening: The game launches at midnight local time on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. The Ultimate Edition costs $99.99.
culture.could: A smooth launch would lift holiday spending on consoles and accessories. A rocky one becomes a warning sign for stretched shoppers. FIOPO read.
you: The preload is about 212 GB. Check your console storage before Thursday instead of buying a drive at launch week prices.

social.headline: Oil hit its lowest since August. Gas is next.
social.caption:
One event, five steps to your wallet. The IEA says oil supply now tops demand, US crude closed at its lowest since August 28, and the gas average is $3.81, down about 54 cents since mid October. Markets still price 91% odds of a Fed hike December 9 (market odds). What it means for you at fiopoin.com

evening.kicker: Evening: the world and your wallet
evening.headline: Tankers hit near Hormuz, yet oil keeps falling.
points: Book holiday flights before a spike
evening.watch: Hormuz traffic after the mine claims, and OPEC+ on November 29.
evening.caption:
Iran's navy says a fourth tanker hit a mine near Hormuz, yet Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44 on Monday. The reason: Gulf exports recovered faster than demand. Diesel dipped below $6 for the first time since September, which eases freight costs with a lag. Our read, labeled as judgment: pump prices drift lower unless shipping is hit hard. More at fiopoin.com.

#FIOPO #OilPrices #MiddleEast #GasPrices #Travel

items.label: Stocks
items.text: The S&P 500 fell 1.9% and the Nasdaq 2.5%, led by chip stocks.

items.label: Nvidia
items.text: Closed at $156.14, down 4.1%, a day before its first report under an interim CEO.

items.label: Oil
items.text: Brent fell 3.55% to $92.44 after the IEA said supply now tops demand.

items.label: Gas
items.text: The AAA national average was $3.81, down from $4.36 in mid October.

items.label: Health
items.text: The FDA approved Roche's Wilserdly, a pill for a hard to treat form of advanced breast cancer.

items.label: Football
items.text: UEFA backed France's Philippe Diallo to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency.

regions.covers: China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Southeast Asia
regions.headline: APEC opens in Shenzhen Wednesday. Trump and Xi meet Thursday.
regions.text: Leaders of 21 economies meet November 18 and 19. The US and China trade truce runs to January 10, 2027.
regions.you: Phones, laptops and appliances made in China are safer to buy before January than after.

regions.covers: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal
regions.headline: India's inflation hit 6.09%, above the central bank's 6% ceiling.
regions.text: October prices rose at the fastest pace in two years, driven by food. Food inflation reached 8.94%, with onions up 116%. The RBI raised its rate to 5.50% in October and meets again December 2 to 4.
regions.you: Sending money home or paying bills in rupees? Another RBI hike in December would raise loan costs there and could support the rupee.

regions.covers: European Union, United Kingdom, Ukraine, Russia
regions.headline: The EU adds Russia sanctions and its largest single payment to Ukraine.
regions.text: Nearly 50 banks and financial firms were sanctioned on Monday, and about €8 billion was approved for Kyiv. Talks last week produced a prisoner swap but no breakthrough.
regions.you: A lasting ceasefire would be the biggest relief for fuel prices in 2027. Until then, energy stays the swing factor.

regions.covers: Gulf states, Iran, Israel, Iraq, Yemen
regions.headline: Tankers hit near Hormuz, yet oil keeps falling.
regions.text: Iran's navy reported a fourth mine strike in 24 hours, a claim not independently confirmed. Gulf exports have recovered faster than demand, the IEA says.
regions.you: Pump prices should keep drifting lower unless shipping is hit hard. FIOPO read, judgment not fact.

regions.covers: DR Congo, Nigeria, Kenya, South Africa, Ethiopia, Egypt
regions.headline: The Ebola outbreak centered in DR Congo has passed 11,000 confirmed cases.
regions.text: CDC counts 11,407 confirmed cases and 5,572 deaths as of November 14, almost all in DR Congo, with cases in Uganda, Kenya, Nigeria and France. This strain has no approved vaccine. CDC says the risk to the American public remains low.
regions.you: Travelers who were in DR Congo in the past 21 days cannot board flights to the US. Check CDC travel notices before any trip to the region.

regions.headline: Brazil's real hit a 12 month low as Petrobras slid.
regions.text: The dollar closed Friday at 5.67 reais, the most in a year. Brazil's central bank holds its rate at 13.75% and decides again December 9. Lula won reelection on October 25.
regions.you: Dollars stretch further in Brazil right now. Travelers and buyers of Brazilian goods benefit; people sending money to Brazil get more reais.

sports.headline: MLB's labor deal expires December 1. A lockout looks likely.
sports.text: MLB proposed a salary cap from 2028 of $258.2 million with a $180.2 million floor. Players oppose a cap. The last cap fight led to the 1994 strike.
sports.you: Hold off on 2027 season tickets and travel packages until a deal is signed, or buy only with a clear refund policy.

sports.headline: India won its first ODI series in New Zealand in seven years, and landed two world events.
sports.text: India won the series 3 to 1 on November 15. The ICC also named India host of the 2029 Champions Trophy and co-host, with Bangladesh, of the 2031 World Cup.
sports.you: Planning to see a world event in India? The 2029 Champions Trophy runs October 9 to 28. Watch for official ticket sales only.

sports.headline: Infantino, unopposed in 2023, now faces a challenger backed by Europe.
sports.text: UEFA's 55 members backed France's Philippe Diallo. The vote is at the FIFA Congress in Rabat in March 2027. UEFA has sued in Florida over Infantino's dropped plan to sell World Cup stakes to investors.
sports.you: FIFA's leader shapes World Cup ticket prices and TV deals. A contested race means more scrutiny of both.

entertainment.headline: GTA 6 arrives Thursday at $79.99. Preorders are estimated near $750 million.
entertainment.text: Sensor Tower estimates about 7.7 million copies were preordered. It launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
entertainment.you: The preload is about 212 GB. Check console storage before Thursday instead of buying a drive at launch week prices.

entertainment.headline: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend has grossed $147.5 million worldwide in 11 days.
entertainment.text: Sony says the Indian epic made $24 million in the US and Canada alone. It reportedly cost Rs 2,000 crore and opens in Brazil, Italy and more markets this week.
entertainment.you: Big Indian releases now play wide in US theaters. Premium format tickets sell out first on opening weekends.

innovation.headline: Anthropic lists Thursday at $70 to $78 a share.
innovation.text: That values it at up to $1.404 trillion, ticker ANT on the Nasdaq. Up to 20% of shares are set aside for retail buyers.
innovation.you: First day prices swing hard. Only risk money you can afford to see drop.

innovation.headline: New US rules limit access to advanced chips through overseas data centers.
innovation.text: Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil face added export licensing. The cost to chipmakers depends on how licenses are granted.
innovation.you: If your retirement fund leans on tech, check how much sits in a few chip stocks.

innovation.headline: FDA approves a new breast cancer pill for patients whose tumors stop responding.
innovation.text: Roche's Wilserdly (giredestrant) treats advanced HR positive, HER2 negative cancer with an ESR1 mutation. In trials it delayed tumor growth. Roche says it could become its best seller.
innovation.you: Patients on hormone therapy can ask their oncologist whether ESR1 testing applies to them.

travel.headline: Tsavo, Kenya: big elephant herds with fewer crowds.
travel.text: Lonely Planet named Tsavo East and West to its Best in Travel 2027 list for wide red earth savannahs and large elephant herds, with fewer visitors than Kenya's famous parks.
travel.you: CDC rates Kenya at Level 1, usual precautions, despite the regional Ebola outbreak. Check the notice again before you book.

image.alt: Wide savanna in Tsavo East National Park with elephants and giraffes

travel.headline: California's redwood coast, picked for 2027.
travel.text: Lonely Planet's 2027 list includes the Northern California coast and redwoods. Redwood National and State Parks protect some of the tallest trees on earth along 40 miles of Pacific coast.
travel.you: Check the official park site for fees, closures and road conditions before you go.

image.alt: Old growth coast redwoods in fog

travel.headline: Book holiday flights before a possible fuel spike.
travel.text: Oil is falling, but our 30 day read still gives a 25% chance Brent spikes above $100. Airfares follow fuel within weeks. The dollar also buys more in Brazil than at any time in a year.
travel.you: Lock in fares you are happy with now. FIOPO read, judgment not fact.

items.text: "GTA 6: Everything You NEED To Know" from TGG passed 2.1 million views ahead of Thursday's launch.
The final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, and leak coverage of it, are among the top trending videos.
#latingrammys and #streamerawards are among the fastest rising hashtags this week.
SpaceX caught a returning Starship upper stage with its launch tower arms for the first time, after 14 orbits. The booster was lost over the Gulf.
India won its first ODI cricket series in New Zealand in seven years, 3 to 1.
India beat Pakistan by one wicket to win the Under-19 Asia Cup, its ninth title.
NASA's Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth.
BepiColombo is entering orbit around Mercury, only the second spacecraft ever to do so.
ESA's Hera is arriving at the asteroid Didymos to study the crater from NASA's DART impact.
Artemis II splashed down off San Diego after a 10 day trip around the Moon, the first crewed lunar voyage in more than 50 years.
NASA's Perseverance set the record for distance driven on another world, more than 45 km on Mars.
The Hubble Space Telescope completed its 200,000th orbit of Earth.
